research_summary: Clean comparison plot with sequential LoRA from SGLang csgmv and overlapped LoRA from Torch/cuBLAS.
Both BF16 and int4 bases include a csgmv sequential LoRA line and a Torch two-stream LoRA line.
Triton LoRA rows are intentionally excluded from this clean plot.
The int4 two-stream Torch LoRA series uses Marlin SM reservation only inside the two-stream Marlin callable.
metadata.r1_o_bf16_recheck: o-projection BF16 base rows updated from 3 single-GPU repeats with warmup=50, iters=100.
metadata.deliverable_title: R1 7B: Torch Two-Stream QLoRA vs BF16 Merged
metadata.note: R1 7B deliverable subset; kernel-only latency, no KV-cache modeling.
